_about: Amendments to the goods rate notifications after 17.09.2025, transcribed from the Gazette of India. The build checks each quoted text against the amending PDF and each target entry against the base schedule. Gazette checked for Ministry of Finance (Department of Revenue) issues through 2026-11-05.

notifications.summary: Re-letters sub-items (a)-(h) inside one description of 09/2025 and re-numbers (i)-(x) inside 10/2025-IT/UT; corrects a cross-reference '2.5%' to '5%' in 10/2025-Integrated Tax. No change to any rate, code or entry.
Moves pan masala and tobacco products from 28% (Schedule VII, omitted) to 40% (Schedule III) and biris to 18% (Schedule II), from 1 February 2026, when compensation cess became nil.

operations.description: Unmanufactured tobacco; tobacco refuse [other than tobacco leaves]
Cigars, cheroots, cigarillos and cigarettes, of tobacco or of tobacco substitutes
Other manufactured tobacco and manufactured tobacco substitutes; homogenised or reconstituted tobacco; tobacco extracts and essences [other than biris]
Products containing tobacco or reconstituted tobacco and intended for inhalation without combustion
Products containing tobacco or nicotine substitutes and intended for inhalation without combustion

operations.quote: the Schedule VII – 14%, and the entries relating thereto shall be omitted

notifications.summary: Updates tariff codes for beverages under 2202 99 to match changes in the Customs Tariff from 1 May 2026.
57th GST Council: sea-weed extract bio-stimulants included in organic fertilisers (5%); retreaded tractor tyres moved to 5%.

operations.description: All goods i.e. animal or vegetable fertilisers or organic fertilisers pre-packaged and labelled. Explanation. – This entry includes, sea-weed extract based bio-stimulants, as registered under Schedule VI to the Fertiliser (Inorganic, Organic or Mixed) (Control) Order, 1985.
Retreaded or used pneumatic tyres of rubber (other than retreaded tractor tyres); solid or cushion tyres, tyre treads and tyre flaps, of rubber

notifications.summary: Compensation cess set to Nil for every entry of the compensation cess schedule from 1 February 2026.
